text:
maria: Quick ask — can someone run a small-batch perf sweep on fused-paged-attn + FlashAttention2? I'm seeing an ~8-12% tail latency regression for batch sizes 1-4 after the kernel reorder PR.

aj: Yep, I can run this. Which exact configs do you want (seq/model/hardware)?

maria: Focus on llama-7b and llama-2-7b, seq_len=256 and 512, prompt lengths 32 and 128. Batch sizes = 1, 2, 4. Test both cold KV (new session) and warm KV cache. Run on p3e and p4d nodes if possible.

ravi: FYI I recently reverted an allocator tweak in branch mem-align-fix — make sure the runs are against main + kernel-reorder (PR #4021) so we reproduce what hit production.

maria: Correct — main with kernel-reorder (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4021).

aj: I'll queue runs. Planning to use the microbench harness. Command I'm about to run:

```
./tools/run_microbench.sh \
  --model llama-7b \
  --engine flash-paged-fuse \
  --batch-sizes 1,2,4 \
  --seq-lens 256,512 \
  --prompts 32,128 \
  --kv-warm-cold both \
  --nvtx --perf-counters \
  --repeat 20 
```

aj: Will capture nvtx traces and perf counters and upload perf.data + nvtx slices to the artifacts bucket when done.

lee: Once you have NVTX, tag me here and I'll slice for GPU stalls / sync points. Also include the raw stdout for token timings — that helps filter kernel-level stalls vs queueing.

sophia: Scheduling note: long sweep on p4d should be low-priority; I'll queue them after 10:00 PST to avoid the infra migration window. If you need faster feedback, run a short 5-run smoke on p3e first.

ops-bot: Canary rollout of kernel-reorder started (canary set: 5 nodes) — 10:15 UTC. Monitoring latency.

sam: If regression is confirmed for small batches, we could add a runtime guard that disables fusion for batch <= 2 as a fallback while we root-cause. I can prototype a heuristic flag.

maria: Good plan. Assigning: @aj to run the initial microbench and upload artifacts, @lee to analyze NVTX slices, @sam to draft a short fallback heuristic if needed. Please paste links to artifacts in this thread. :thumbsup:

aj: Starting the smoke runs now on p3e; will post results (~20m).

lee: I might also try a quick local run with nvprof attached to capture cudaDriver sync stacks if the NVTX looks ambiguous.

ravi: One more note — test both with and without the mem-align-fix revert (I can push a small branch) to rule out allocator effects.

maria: Thanks everyone — ping here when you have the artifacts. Keeping this thread for async updates. :eyes:
